# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: true

library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

# Set theme for all plots
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 14))
```

# Import and Filter Data

```{r}
# Define file path
file_path <- "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/group/screening/01_screening_allinterested_20250909T150100.xlsx"

# Import data
descriptives <- read_excel(file_path)

# Filter selected participants (excluding P11)
selected_ids <- c("P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P09", "P10")
descriptives <- descriptives %>%
  filter(email_schedule %in% selected_ids)
```

# Calculate BMI

```{r}
descriptives <- descriptives %>%
  mutate(
    height_m = as.numeric(height) / 100,
    bmi = weight / (height_m^2)
  )
```

# Calculate PSQI Scores

```{r}
descriptives <- descriptives %>%
  mutate(
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Convert time variables to decimal hours
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    psqi_1_decimal = hour(psqi_1) + minute(psqi_1)/60,
    
    # FIX: P01 reported 12:00 (noon) instead of 00:00 (midnight)
    psqi_1_decimal = if_else(
      email_schedule == "P01" & psqi_1_decimal == 12.0,
      0.0,
      psqi_1_decimal
    ),
    
    psqi_3_decimal = hour(psqi_3) + minute(psqi_3)/60,
    
    # Ensure numeric variables are numeric
    psqi_2 = as.numeric(psqi_2),
    psqi_4 = as.numeric(psqi_4),
    
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Component 1: Subjective sleep quality
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Note: psqi_6 = Question 9 in questionnaire (sleep quality rating)
    psqi_comp1 = psqi_6,
    
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Component 2: Sleep latency
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 1: Score psqi_2 (sleep latency in minutes)
    psqi_comp2_score2 = case_when(
      psqi_2 <= 15 ~ 0,
      psqi_2 <= 30 ~ 1,
      psqi_2 <= 60 ~ 2,
      psqi_2 > 60 ~ 3
    ),
    
    # Step 2: Add psqi_5a (trouble falling asleep)
    psqi_comp2_sum = psqi_comp2_score2 + psqi_5a,
    
    # Step 3: Convert sum to component score
    psqi_comp2 = case_when(
      psqi_comp2_sum == 0 ~ 0,
      psqi_comp2_sum <= 2 ~ 1,
      psqi_comp2_sum <= 4 ~ 2,
      psqi_comp2_sum <= 6 ~ 3
    ),
    
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Component 3: Sleep duration
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    psqi_comp3 = case_when(
      psqi_4 > 7 ~ 0,
      psqi_4 >= 6 ~ 1,
      psqi_4 >= 5 ~ 2,
      psqi_4 < 5 ~ 3
    ),
    
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Component 4: Habitual sleep efficiency
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Calculate time in bed (handles overnight periods)
    time_in_bed = if_else(
      psqi_3_decimal < psqi_1_decimal,
      (24 - psqi_1_decimal) + psqi_3_decimal,
      psqi_3_decimal - psqi_1_decimal
    ),
    
    # Calculate sleep efficiency percentage
    sleep_efficiency = (psqi_4 / time_in_bed) * 100,
    
    # Convert to component score
    psqi_comp4 = case_when(
      sleep_efficiency >= 85 ~ 0,
      sleep_efficiency >= 75 ~ 1,
      sleep_efficiency >= 65 ~ 2,
      sleep_efficiency < 65 ~ 3
    ),
    
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Component 5: Sleep disturbances
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Sum items 5b through 5i (8 standard items)
    psqi_comp5_sum = psqi_5b + psqi_5c + psqi_5d + psqi_5e + psqi_5f + 
      psqi_5g + psqi_5h + psqi_5i,
    
    # Add psqi_5othera if present (optional 9th item)
    psqi_comp5_sum = if_else(!is.na(psqi_5othera), 
                             psqi_comp5_sum + psqi_5othera, 
                             psqi_comp5_sum),
    
    # Convert sum to component score
    psqi_comp5 = case_when(
      psqi_comp5_sum == 0 ~ 0,
      psqi_comp5_sum <= 9 ~ 1,
      psqi_comp5_sum <= 18 ~ 2,
      psqi_comp5_sum > 18 ~ 3
    ),
    
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Component 6: Use of sleeping medication
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Note: psqi_7 = Question 6 in standard PSQI (sleep medication)
    psqi_comp6 = psqi_7,
    
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Component 7: Daytime dysfunction
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Sum psqi_8 (staying awake) and psqi_9 (enthusiasm)
    # Note: These are Questions 7-8 in standard PSQI
    psqi_comp7_sum = psqi_8 + psqi_9,
    
    # Convert sum to component score
    psqi_comp7 = case_when(
      psqi_comp7_sum == 0 ~ 0,
      psqi_comp7_sum >= 1 & psqi_comp7_sum <= 2 ~ 1,
      psqi_comp7_sum >= 3 & psqi_comp7_sum <= 4 ~ 2,
      psqi_comp7_sum >= 5 ~ 3
    ),
    
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Global PSQI Score
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    psqi_total = psqi_comp1 + psqi_comp2 + psqi_comp3 + psqi_comp4 + 
      psqi_comp5 + psqi_comp6 + psqi_comp7
  )
```

# Verify PSQI Calculations

```{r}
descriptives %>%
  select(email_schedule, psqi_comp1, psqi_comp2, psqi_comp3, psqi_comp4, 
         psqi_comp5, psqi_comp6, psqi_comp7, psqi_total) %>%
```

# Create Demographics Table

```{r}
demographics_table <- descriptives %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    
    # Age
    `Age (years)` = sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", 
                            mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), 
                            sd(age, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    # Height
    `Height (cm)` = sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", 
                            mean(as.numeric(height), na.rm = TRUE), 
                            sd(as.numeric(height), na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    # Weight
    `Weight (kg)` = sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", 
                            mean(weight, na.rm = TRUE), 
                            sd(weight, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    # BMI
    `BMI (kg/m²)` = sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", 
                            mean(bmi, na.rm = TRUE), 
                            sd(bmi, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    # Sex
    `Sex (% female)` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 
                               sum(sex == 2, na.rm = TRUE) / n() * 100),
    
    # PSQI
    `PSQI (score)` = sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", 
                             mean(psqi_total, na.rm = TRUE), 
                             sd(psqi_total, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Characteristic")

colnames(demographics_table) <- c("Characteristic", "Value")

# Display demographics table
demographics_table %>%
  kable(align = c("l", "r"), 
        caption = "Participant Demographics (N = 9)") %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Arial") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "3in") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "2in")

print(demographics_table)
```

## LEBA Plot Function

```{r}
create_leba_plot <- function(var_name) {
  
  plot_data <- descriptives %>%
    select(participant_id = email_schedule, response = all_of(var_name)) %>%
    count(response) %>%
    complete(response = 1:5, fill = list(n = 0))
  
  title_info <- leba_titles[[var_name]]
  
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = factor(response), y = n)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#4A90E2", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("1" = "Never", "2" = "Rarely", 
                                "3" = "Sometimes", "4" = "Often", "5" = "Always")) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = 0:9, limits = c(0, 9),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))) +
    labs(
      title = to_sentence_case(title_info$title),
      subtitle = to_sentence_case(title_info$question),
      x = "Response category",
      y = "Number of participants"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(15, 10, 10, 10)
    )
}
```

## Generate All Plots

```{r}
leba_vars <- names(leba_titles)
leba_plots <- lapply(leba_vars, create_leba_plot)
names(leba_plots) <- leba_vars
```

## Updated LEBA Plot Function for Panels

```{r}
create_leba_plot <- function(var_name) {
  plot_data <- descriptives %>%
    select(participant_id = email_schedule, response = all_of(var_name)) %>%
    count(response) %>%
    complete(response = 1:5, fill = list(n = 0))
  
  title_info <- leba_titles[[var_name]]
  
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = factor(response), y = n)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#4A90E2", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = 1:5) +  
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = 0:9, limits = c(0, 9),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))) +
    labs(
      title = to_sentence_case(title_info$title),
      subtitle = shorten_subtitle(to_sentence_case(title_info$question)),
      x = "Response category",
      y = "Number of participants"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 1,  # square
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 8, 8, 8)
    )
}
```

# Self-Reported Sleep and Wake-Time Adherence Analysis 

## Data Preparation Sleep Questionnaires

**Goal:** Download raw data for sleep diaries (REDCap) and create an Excel file called `01_sleep_ques_cleaned_20251010THHMMSS` with all sleep questionnaires from group 1-4 cleaned and combined.

## Define File Paths
```{r}
# Define base path
base_path <- "C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/group/sleep_questionnaires"

# Define file paths for all groups
file_paths <- list(
  group1 = file.path(base_path, "group1", "01_sleepquest_20250704T100000.xlsx"),
  group2 = file.path(base_path, "group2", "01_sleepquest_20250717T100000.xlsx"),
  group3 = file.path(base_path, "group3", "01_sleepquest_20250814T100000.xlsx"),
  group4 = file.path(base_path, "group4", "01_sleepquest_20250831T100000.xlsx")
)
```

## Read Data from All Groups
```{r}
# Initialize list to store dataframes
df_list <- list()

# Read each file
for (group in names(file_paths)) {
  cat(sprintf("Reading %s: %s\n", group, basename(file_paths[[group]])))
  
  # Read Excel file
  df <- read_excel(file_paths[[group]])
  
  # Add group identifier
  df$group <- group
  
  # Add to list
  df_list[[group]] <- df
  
  cat(sprintf("  - Dimensions: %d rows x %d columns\n", nrow(df), ncol(df)))
}
```

## Standardize Data Types
```{r}
# Standardize data types before combining
df_list <- lapply(df_list, function(df) {
  # Store time columns separately (they are POSIXct with date 1899-12-31)
  time_cols <- c("sd_time_intobed", "sd_time_trysleep", "sd_time_finalawake", "sd_time_outbed")
  
  # Extract just the time part BEFORE converting to character
  for (col in time_cols) {
    if (col %in% names(df) && inherits(df[[col]], c("POSIXct", "POSIXt"))) {
      df[[col]] <- format(df[[col]], "%H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")
    }
  }
  
  # Convert remaining POSIXct/datetime columns to character
  datetime_cols <- sapply(df, function(x) inherits(x, c("POSIXct", "POSIXt", "Date")))
  if (any(datetime_cols)) {
    df[datetime_cols] <- lapply(df[datetime_cols], as.character)
  }
  
  return(df)
})
```

## Combine Datasets
```{r}
# Combine all dataframes
sleep <- bind_rows(df_list)

cat(sprintf("\nCombined dataset dimensions: %d rows x %d columns\n\n", 
            nrow(sleep), ncol(sleep)))
```

## Exclude P11 (Study Dropout)
```{r}
# Exclude P11 if present (study dropout)
initial_rows <- nrow(sleep)
sleep <- sleep %>%
  filter(participant_id != "P11")
excluded_rows <- initial_rows - nrow(sleep)

if (excluded_rows > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("Excluded %d rows for P11 (study dropout)\n\n", excluded_rows))
}
```

## Select and Rename Columns
```{r}
# Select and rename columns, filter complete entries
sleep <- sleep %>%
  select(
    timestamp_auto = initial_form_sleep_dairy_timestamp,
    participant_id = participant_id,
    timestamp_self = date,
    sd_time_intobed,
    sd_time_trysleep,
    sd_mins_fallasleep,
    sd_total_awakenings,
    sd_duration_awakenings,
    sd_time_finalawake,
    sd_time_outbed,
    sd_sleepquality_rating,
    sd_rested_rating,
    sd_naps_total_daybefore,
    sd_naps_duration_daybefore,
    medication_daybefore,
    medication_daybefore_specify,
    comments,
    timestamp_compl_auto = completed_datetime,
    sleep_diary_complete,
    group
  ) %>%
  filter(sleep_diary_complete == 2)  # Keep only complete entries

cat(sprintf("After filtering complete entries: %d rows\n\n", nrow(sleep)))
```

## Standardize Participant IDs
```{r}
# Standardize participant_id format
sleep <- sleep %>%
  mutate(
    participant_id = toupper(trimws(participant_id)),
    participant_id = gsub("O", "0", participant_id),
    participant_id = case_when(
      participant_id == "6" ~ "P06",
      !grepl("^P", participant_id) ~ paste0("P", sprintf("%02d", as.numeric(participant_id))),
      TRUE ~ participant_id
    )
  )

cat("Participant IDs after standardization:\n")
print(table(sleep$participant_id))
cat("\n")
```

## Convert Timestamps
```{r}
# Convert timestamps (Character to POSIXct)
sleep <- sleep %>%
  mutate(
    timestamp_auto = as.POSIXct(timestamp_auto, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC"),
    timestamp_self = as.POSIXct(timestamp_self, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC"),
    timestamp_compl_auto = as.POSIXct(timestamp_compl_auto, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")
  )
```

## Add Expected Sleep Schedule
```{r}
# Add expected bedtime and waketime
sleep <- sleep %>%
  mutate(
    expected_bedtime = case_when(
      participant_id %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03") ~ "00:00:00",
      participant_id %in% c("P04", "P05") ~ "22:00:00",
      participant_id %in% c("P06", "P07", "P09") ~ "23:30:00",
      participant_id == "P10" ~ "23:00:00",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    expected_waketime = case_when(
      participant_id %in% c("P01", "P02", "P03") ~ "08:30:00",
      participant_id %in% c("P04", "P05") ~ "07:00:00",
      participant_id == "P06" ~ "08:30:00",
      participant_id == "P07" ~ "07:30:00",
      participant_id == "P09" ~ "08:00:00",
      participant_id == "P10" ~ "08:00:00",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Check result
head(sleep[, c("participant_id", "expected_bedtime", "expected_waketime")])
```

## Data Corrections
```{r}
# Remove P05 duplicate entry for 2025-07-01 09:06:00
sleep_sub <- sleep_sub %>%
  filter(!(participant_id == "P05" & 
           timestamp_self == as.POSIXct("2025-07-01 09:06:00", tz = "UTC")))

# Add missing P09 03.08 entry from raw data
raw_p09 <- readxl::read_excel("C:/Users/anton/OneDrive/AfterGlow/data/raw/group/sleep_questionnaires/group3/01_sleepquest_20250814T100000.xlsx")

missing_entry <- raw_p09 %>%
  filter(participant_id == "P09",
         as.Date(date) == as.Date("2025-08-03")) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("sd_time_"), ~format(., "%H:%M:%S")))

missing_entry_clean <- missing_entry %>%
  rename(timestamp_self = sleep_diary_timestamp,
         timestamp_compl_auto = completed_datetime) %>%
  mutate(
    timestamp_auto = as.POSIXct(paste(as.Date(date), "07:00:00"), tz = "UTC"),
    group = "3",
    expected_bedtime = "23:30",
    expected_waketime = "08:00"
  ) %>%
  select(all_of(colnames(sleep_sub)))

sleep_sub <- bind_rows(sleep_sub, missing_entry_clean)

# Correct problematic dates (12:00-format instead of intended 24:00-time format)
sleep_sub <- sleep_sub %>%
  mutate(
    sd_time_trysleep = case_when(
      participant_id == "P05" & date(timestamp_self) == as.Date("2025-06-24") ~ "22:15:00",
      participant_id == "P05" & date(timestamp_self) == as.Date("2025-07-05") ~ "23:15:00",
      participant_id == "P06" & 
        date(timestamp_self) >= as.Date("2025-07-29") & 
        date(timestamp_self) <= as.Date("2025-08-07") & 
        str_detect(sd_time_trysleep, "^12:") ~ 
        str_replace(sd_time_trysleep, "^12:", "00:"),
      participant_id == "P07" & 
        date(timestamp_self) >= as.Date("2025-07-21") & 
        date(timestamp_self) <= as.Date("2025-07-28") & 
        str_detect(sd_time_trysleep, "^11:") ~ 
        str_replace(sd_time_trysleep, "^11:", "23:"),
      TRUE ~ sd_time_trysleep
    ))
```

```{r}
bedtime_data_P01 <- tibble(
  date = as.Date(c(
    "2025-06-09", "2025-06-10", "2025-06-11", "2025-06-12", "2025-06-13", "2025-06-14", "2025-06-15",

    "2025-06-27", "2025-06-28", "2025-06-29", "2025-06-30", "2025-07-01", "2025-07-02", "2025-07-03"
  )),

                 levels = c("Pre-Ambulatory", "Laboratory", "Post-Ambulatory")),
  time = c(

    bedtime_04_preamb_P01$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_05_preamb_P01$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_06_preamb_P01$sd_time_trysleep,
    bedtime_07_preamb_P01$sd_time_trysleep,
    bedtime_01_lab_P01$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_02_lab_P01$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_03_lab_P01$sd_time_trysleep,
    bedtime_04_lab_P01$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_05_lab_P01$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_06_lab_P01$sd_time_trysleep,
    bedtime_07_lab_P01$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_08_lab_P01$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_09_lab_P01$sd_time_trysleep,
    bedtime_10_lab_P01$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_11_lab_P01$sd_time_trysleep,
    bedtime_01_postamb_P01$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_02_postamb_P01$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_03_postamb_P01$sd_time_trysleep,
    bedtime_04_postamb_P01$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_05_postamb_P01$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_06_postamb_P01$sd_time_trysleep,
    bedtime_07_postamb_P01$sd_time_trysleep
  )
) %>%

    hour = hour(hms(time)) + minute(hms(time))/60,
```

### Identify Outliers and Create Plots
```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10

# Identify excluded values for bedtime
excluded_bedtime_P01 <- bedtime_data_P01 %>%
  filter(hour_adj < 21 | hour_adj > 26) %>%
  mutate(label = time)

# Identify excluded values for waketime
excluded_waketime_P01 <- waketime_data_P01 %>%
  filter(hour < 6 | hour > 11) %>%
  mutate(label = time)

# P01 Bedtime plot
p_bedtime_P01 <- ggplot(bedtime_data_P01, aes(x = date, y = hour_adj)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 24, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = bedtime_color, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = bedtime_color, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  # Add annotations for excluded values
  {if(nrow(excluded_bedtime_P01) > 0) {
    geom_point(data = excluded_bedtime_P01, aes(x = date, y = 25.7), 
               size = 3, color = bedtime_color, shape = 17)
  }} +
  {if(nrow(excluded_bedtime_P01) > 0) {
    geom_text(data = excluded_bedtime_P01, aes(x = date, y = 25.9, label = label), 
              size = 3, color = bedtime_color, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")
  }} +
  facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "P01 - Bedtime Adherence", 
       subtitle = "Dashed line = Expected bedtime (00:00) | Triangles indicate values outside scale",
       x = "Date", y = "Bedtime") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(21, 26, 0.5),
                     limits = c(21, 26),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(ifelse(x >= 24, x - 24, x)), 
                                                  round((ifelse(x >= 24, x - 24, x) %% 1) * 60))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%d.%m") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10))

print(p_bedtime_P01)

# P01 Waketime plot

  geom_hline(yintercept = 8, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 9, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 8, ymax = 9, alpha = 0.1, fill = "green") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = waketime_color, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = waketime_color, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  # Add annotations for excluded values
  {if(nrow(excluded_waketime_P01) > 0) {
    geom_point(data = excluded_waketime_P01, aes(x = date, y = 10.7), 
               size = 3, color = waketime_color, shape = 17)
  }} +
  {if(nrow(excluded_waketime_P01) > 0) {
    geom_text(data = excluded_waketime_P01, aes(x = date, y = 10.9, label = label), 
              size = 2.5, color = waketime_color, hjust = 0.5)
  }} +
  facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "P01 - Waketime Adherence", 
       subtitle = "Dashed lines = Allowed window (08:00 - 09:00)",
```

### Deviation Analysis
```{r}
# Pre-Ambulatory Phase
dev_bedtime_preamb_p01 <- bedtime_data_P01 %>%
  filter(phase == "Pre-Ambulatory") %>%
  mutate(
    target = 24,
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs((hour_adj - target) * 60),
    deviation_minutes_signed = (hour_adj - target) * 60
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

dev_waketime_preamb_p01 <- waketime_data_P01 %>%
  filter(phase == "Pre-Ambulatory") %>%
  mutate(
    window_start = 8,    # 08:00
    window_end = 9,      # 09:00
    deviation_minutes_signed = case_when(
      hour < window_start ~ (hour - window_start) * 60,  # too early = negative
      hour > window_end ~ (hour - window_end) * 60,      # too late = positive
      TRUE ~ 0                                            # perfectly aligned with time window = 0
    ),
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs(deviation_minutes_signed)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

# Laboratory Phase
dev_bedtime_lab_p01 <- bedtime_data_P01 %>%
  filter(phase == "Laboratory") %>%
  mutate(
    target = 24,
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs((hour_adj - target) * 60),
    deviation_minutes_signed = (hour_adj - target) * 60
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

dev_waketime_lab_p01 <- waketime_data_P01 %>%
  filter(phase == "Laboratory") %>%
  mutate(
    window_start = 8,    # 08:00
    window_end = 9,      # 09:00
    deviation_minutes_signed = case_when(
      hour < window_start ~ (hour - window_start) * 60,  # too early = negative
      hour > window_end ~ (hour - window_end) * 60,      # too late = positive
      TRUE ~ 0                                            # perfectly aligned with time window = 0
    ),
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs(deviation_minutes_signed)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

# Post-Ambulatory Phase
dev_bedtime_postamb_p01 <- bedtime_data_P01 %>%
  filter(phase == "Post-Ambulatory") %>%
  mutate(
    target = 24,
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs((hour_adj - target) * 60),
    deviation_minutes_signed = (hour_adj - target) * 60
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

dev_waketime_postamb_p01 <- waketime_data_P01 %>%
  filter(phase == "Post-Ambulatory") %>%
  mutate(
    window_start = 8,    # 08:00
    window_end = 9,      # 09:00
    deviation_minutes_signed = case_when(
      hour < window_start ~ (hour - window_start) * 60,  # too early = negative
      hour > window_end ~ (hour - window_end) * 60,      # too late = positive
      TRUE ~ 0                                            # perfectly aligned with time window = 0
    ),
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs(deviation_minutes_signed)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

# Create summary table
bind_rows(
  dev_bedtime_preamb_p01 %>% mutate(phase = "Pre-Ambulatory", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_bedtime_lab_p01 %>% mutate(phase = "Laboratory", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_bedtime_postamb_p01 %>% mutate(phase = "Post-Ambulatory", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_waketime_preamb_p01 %>% mutate(phase = "Pre-Ambulatory", measure = "Waketime"),
  dev_waketime_lab_p01 %>% mutate(phase = "Laboratory", measure = "Waketime"),
  dev_waketime_postamb_p01 %>% mutate(phase = "Post-Ambulatory", measure = "Waketime")
) %>%
  select(measure, phase, mean_dev_signed, sd_dev_signed, mean_dev_abs, sd_dev_abs, n) %>%
  kable(
    digits = 1,
    col.names = c("Measure", "Phase", "Mean Deviation (min)", "SD (min)", 
                  "Mean Absolute Deviation (min)", "SD Absolute (min)", "N"),
    caption = "P01 Sleep Schedule Adherence",
    align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "c")
  ) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Arial") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  pack_rows("Bedtime", 1, 3) %>%
  pack_rows("Waketime", 4, 6)
```

### Identify Outliers and Create Plots
```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10

# Identify excluded values for bedtime with y_offset
excluded_bedtime_P02 <- bedtime_data_P02 %>%
  filter(hour_adj < 21 | hour_adj > 26) %>%
  mutate(label = time) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(y_offset = rep(c(25.9, 25.7), length.out = n()))

# Identify excluded values for waketime with bidirectional positioning
excluded_waketime_P02 <- waketime_data_P02 %>%
  filter(hour < 6 | hour > 11) %>%
  mutate(
    label = time,
    triangle_y = ifelse(hour < 6, 6.3, 10.7),
    text_y = ifelse(hour < 6, 6.1, 10.9)
  )

# P02 Bedtime plot
p_bedtime_P02 <- ggplot(bedtime_data_P02, aes(x = date, y = hour_adj)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 24, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = bedtime_color, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = bedtime_color, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  {if(nrow(excluded_bedtime_P02) > 0) {
    geom_point(data = excluded_bedtime_P02, aes(x = date, y = 25.5), 
               size = 3, color = bedtime_color, shape = 17)
  }} +
  {if(nrow(excluded_bedtime_P02) > 0) {
    geom_text(data = excluded_bedtime_P02, aes(x = date, y = y_offset, label = label), 
              size = 3, color = bedtime_color, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")
  }} +
  facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "P02 - Bedtime Adherence", 
       subtitle = "Dashed line = Expected bedtime (00:00) | Triangles indicate values outside scale | Note: Missing days 14.06 & 26.06",
       x = "Date", y = "Bedtime") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(21, 26, 0.5),
                     limits = c(21, 26),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(ifelse(x >= 24, x - 24, x)), 
                                                  round((ifelse(x >= 24, x - 24, x) %% 1) * 60))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%d.%m") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10))

print(p_bedtime_P02)

# P02 Waketime plot
p_waketime_P02 <- ggplot(waketime_data_P02_plot, aes(x = date, y = hour)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 8, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 9, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 8, ymax = 9, alpha = 0.1, fill = "green") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = waketime_color, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = waketime_color, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  {if(nrow(excluded_waketime_P02) > 0) {
    geom_point(data = excluded_waketime_P02, aes(x = date, y = triangle_y), 
               size = 3, color = waketime_color, shape = 17)
  }} +
  {if(nrow(excluded_waketime_P02) > 0) {
    geom_text(data = excluded_waketime_P02, aes(x = date, y = text_y, label = label), 
              size = 3, color = waketime_color, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")
  }} +
  facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "P02 - Waketime Adherence", 
       subtitle = "Dashed lines = Allowed window (08:00 - 09:00) | Note: Missing days 14.06 & 26.06",
       x = "Date", y = "Waketime") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(6, 11, 0.5),
                     limits = c(6, 11),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(x), round((x %% 1) * 60))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%d.%m") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10))

print(p_waketime_P02)
```

### Deviation Analysis
```{r}
# Pre-Ambulatory Phase
dev_bedtime_preamb_p02 <- bedtime_data_P02 %>%
  filter(phase == "Pre-Ambulatory") %>%
  mutate(
    target = 24,
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs((hour_adj - target) * 60),
    deviation_minutes_signed = (hour_adj - target) * 60
  ) %>%
  summarise(

    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
```

```{r}
bedtime_data_P03 <- tibble(
  date = as.Date(c("2025-06-09", "2025-06-10", "2025-06-11", "2025-06-12", "2025-06-13", "2025-06-14", "2025-06-15",

  phase = factor(c(rep("Pre-Ambulatory", 7), rep("Laboratory", 11), rep("Post-Ambulatory", 7)),
                 levels = c("Pre-Ambulatory", "Laboratory", "Post-Ambulatory")),
  time = c(bedtime_01_preamb_P03$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_02_preamb_P03$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_03_preamb_P03$sd_time_trysleep,
           bedtime_04_preamb_P03$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_05_preamb_P03$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_06_preamb_P03$sd_time_trysleep,
           bedtime_07_preamb_P03$sd_time_trysleep,

           bedtime_04_lab_P03$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_05_lab_P03$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_06_lab_P03$sd_time_trysleep,
           bedtime_07_lab_P03$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_08_lab_P03$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_09_lab_P03$sd_time_trysleep,
           bedtime_10_lab_P03$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_11_lab_P03$sd_time_trysleep,
           bedtime_01_postamb_P03$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_02_postamb_P03$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_03_postamb_P03$sd_time_trysleep,
```

### Identify Outliers and Create Plots
```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10

# Identify excluded values for bedtime with y_offset
excluded_bedtime_P03 <- bedtime_data_P03 %>%
  filter(hour_adj < 21 | hour_adj > 26) %>%
  mutate(label = time) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(y_offset = rep(c(25.9, 25.7), length.out = n()))

# Identify excluded values for waketime
excluded_waketime_P03 <- waketime_data_P03 %>%
  filter(hour < 6 | hour > 11) %>%
  mutate(label = time)

# P03 Bedtime plot
p_bedtime_P03 <- ggplot(bedtime_data_P03, aes(x = date, y = hour_adj)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 24, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = bedtime_color, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = bedtime_color, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  {if(nrow(excluded_bedtime_P03) > 0) {
    geom_point(data = excluded_bedtime_P03, aes(x = date, y = 25.5), 
               size = 3, color = bedtime_color, shape = 17)
  }} +
  {if(nrow(excluded_bedtime_P03) > 0) {
    geom_text(data = excluded_bedtime_P03, aes(x = date, y = y_offset, label = label), 
              size = 3, color = bedtime_color, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")
  }} +
  facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "P03 - Bedtime Adherence", 
       subtitle = "Dashed line = Expected bedtime (00:00) | Triangles indicate values outside scale",
       x = "Date", y = "Bedtime") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(21, 26, 0.5),
                     limits = c(21, 26),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(ifelse(x >= 24, x - 24, x)), 
                                                  round((ifelse(x >= 24, x - 24, x) %% 1) * 60))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%d.%m") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10))

print(p_bedtime_P03)

# P03 Waketime plot
p_waketime_P03 <- ggplot(waketime_data_P03, aes(x = date, y = hour)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 8, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 9, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 8, ymax = 9, alpha = 0.1, fill = "green") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = waketime_color, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = waketime_color, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  {if(nrow(excluded_waketime_P03) > 0) {
    geom_point(data = excluded_waketime_P03, aes(x = date, y = 10.7), 
               size = 3, color = waketime_color, shape = 17)
  }} +
  {if(nrow(excluded_waketime_P03) > 0) {
    geom_text(data = excluded_waketime_P03, aes(x = date, y = 10.9, label = label), 
              size = 2.5, color = waketime_color, hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.3)
  }} +
  facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "P03 - Waketime Adherence", 
       subtitle = "Dashed lines = Allowed window (08:00 - 09:00)",
       x = "Date", y = "Waketime") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(6, 11, 0.5),
                     limits = c(6, 11),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(x), round((x %% 1) * 60))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%d.%m") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10))

print(p_waketime_P03)
```

```{r}
# Laboratory Phase

    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

dev_waketime_lab_p03 <- waketime_data_P03 %>%
  filter(phase == "Laboratory") %>%
  mutate(
    window_start = 8,
    window_end = 9,
    deviation_minutes_signed = case_when(
      hour < window_start ~ (hour - window_start) * 60,
      hour > window_end ~ (hour - window_end) * 60,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs(deviation_minutes_signed)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

# Post-Ambulatory Phase
dev_bedtime_postamb_p03 <- bedtime_data_P03 %>%
  filter(phase == "Post-Ambulatory") %>%
  mutate(
    target = 24,
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs((hour_adj - target) * 60),
    deviation_minutes_signed = (hour_adj - target) * 60
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

dev_waketime_postamb_p03 <- waketime_data_P03 %>%
  filter(phase == "Post-Ambulatory") %>%
  mutate(
    window_start = 8,
    window_end = 9,
    deviation_minutes_signed = case_when(
      hour < window_start ~ (hour - window_start) * 60,
      hour > window_end ~ (hour - window_end) * 60,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs(deviation_minutes_signed)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

# Create summary table
bind_rows(
  dev_bedtime_preamb_p03 %>% mutate(phase = "Pre-Ambulatory", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_bedtime_lab_p03 %>% mutate(phase = "Laboratory", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_bedtime_postamb_p03 %>% mutate(phase = "Post-Ambulatory", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_waketime_preamb_p03 %>% mutate(phase = "Pre-Ambulatory", measure = "Waketime"),
  dev_waketime_lab_p03 %>% mutate(phase = "Laboratory", measure = "Waketime"),
  dev_waketime_postamb_p03 %>% mutate(phase = "Post-Ambulatory", measure = "Waketime")
) %>%
  select(measure, phase, mean_dev_signed, sd_dev_signed, mean_dev_abs, sd_dev_abs, n) %>%
  kable(
    digits = 1,
    col.names = c("Measure", "Phase", "Mean Deviation (min)", "SD (min)", 
                  "Mean Absolute Deviation (min)", "SD Absolute (min)", "N"),
    caption = "P03 Sleep Schedule Adherence",
    align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "c")
  ) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Arial") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  pack_rows("Bedtime", 1, 3) %>%
  pack_rows("Waketime", 4, 6)
```

### Identify Outliers and Create Plots
```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10

# Identify excluded values for bedtime with y_offset
excluded_bedtime_P04 <- bedtime_data_P04 %>%
  filter(hour_adj < 21 | hour_adj > 26) %>%
  mutate(label = time) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(y_offset = rep(c(25.9, 25.7), length.out = n()))

# Identify excluded values for waketime
excluded_waketime_P04 <- waketime_data_P04 %>%
  filter(hour < 6 | hour > 11) %>%
  mutate(label = time)

# P04 Bedtime plot
p_bedtime_P04 <- ggplot(bedtime_data_P04, aes(x = date, y = hour_adj)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 22, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = bedtime_color, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = bedtime_color, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  {if(nrow(excluded_bedtime_P04) > 0) {
    geom_point(data = excluded_bedtime_P04, aes(x = date, y = 25.5), 
               size = 3, color = bedtime_color, shape = 17)
  }} +
  {if(nrow(excluded_bedtime_P04) > 0) {
    geom_text(data = excluded_bedtime_P04, aes(x = date, y = y_offset, label = label), 
              size = 3, color = bedtime_color, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")
  }} +
  facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "P04 - Bedtime Adherence", 
       subtitle = "Dashed line = Expected bedtime (22:00)",
       x = "Date", y = "Bedtime") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(21, 26, 0.5),
                     limits = c(21, 26),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(ifelse(x >= 24, x - 24, x)), 
                                                  round((ifelse(x >= 24, x - 24, x) %% 1) * 60))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%d.%m") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10))

print(p_bedtime_P04)

# P04 Waketime plot
p_waketime_P04 <- ggplot(waketime_data_P04, aes(x = date, y = hour)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 6.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 7.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 6.5, ymax = 7.5, alpha = 0.1, fill = "green") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = waketime_color, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = waketime_color, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  {if(nrow(excluded_waketime_P04) > 0) {
    geom_point(data = excluded_waketime_P04, aes(x = date, y = 10.7), 
               size = 3, color = waketime_color, shape = 17)
  }} +
  {if(nrow(excluded_waketime_P04) > 0) {
    geom_text(data = excluded_waketime_P04, aes(x = date, y = 10.9, label = label), 
              size = 3, color = waketime_color, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")
  }} +
  facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "P04 - Waketime Adherence", 
       subtitle = "Dashed lines = Allowed window (06:30 - 07:30)",
       x = "Date", y = "Waketime") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(6, 11, 0.5),
                     limits = c(6, 11),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(x), round((x %% 1) * 60))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%d.%m") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10))

print(p_waketime_P04)
```

```{r}
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

# Create summary table
bind_rows(
  dev_bedtime_preamb_p04 %>% mutate(phase = "Pre-Ambulatory", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_bedtime_lab_p04 %>% mutate(phase = "Laboratory", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_bedtime_postamb_p04 %>% mutate(phase = "Post-Ambulatory", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_waketime_preamb_p04 %>% mutate(phase = "Pre-Ambulatory", measure = "Waketime"),
  dev_waketime_lab_p04 %>% mutate(phase = "Laboratory", measure = "Waketime"),
  dev_waketime_postamb_p04 %>% mutate(phase = "Post-Ambulatory", measure = "Waketime")
) %>%
  select(measure, phase, mean_dev_signed, sd_dev_signed, mean_dev_abs, sd_dev_abs, n) %>%
  kable(
    digits = 1,
    col.names = c("Measure", "Phase", "Mean Deviation (min)", "SD (min)", 
                  "Mean Absolute Deviation (min)", "SD Absolute (min)", "N"),
    caption = "P04 Sleep Schedule Adherence",
    align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "c")
  ) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Arial") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  pack_rows("Bedtime", 1, 3) %>%
  pack_rows("Waketime", 4, 6)
```

## P05 Analysis

### Create Data Tibbles
```{r}
bedtime_data_P05 <- tibble(
  date = as.Date(c("2025-06-23", "2025-06-24", "2025-06-25", "2025-06-26", "2025-06-27", "2025-06-28", "2025-06-29",

  phase = factor(c(rep("Pre-Ambulatory", 7), rep("Laboratory", 10), rep("Post-Ambulatory", 7)),
                 levels = c("Pre-Ambulatory", "Laboratory", "Post-Ambulatory")),
  time = c(bedtime_01_preamb_P05$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_02_preamb_P05$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_03_preamb_P05$sd_time_trysleep,
           bedtime_04_preamb_P05$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_05_preamb_P05$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_06_preamb_P05$sd_time_trysleep,
           bedtime_07_preamb_P05$sd_time_trysleep,
           bedtime_01_lab_P05$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_02_lab_P05$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_03_lab_P05$sd_time_trysleep,
           bedtime_04_lab_P05$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_05_lab_P05$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_06_lab_P05$sd_time_trysleep,
           bedtime_07_lab_P05$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_08_lab_P05$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_09_lab_P05$sd_time_trysleep,
           bedtime_10_lab_P05$sd_time_trysleep,
```

### Identify Outliers and Create Plots
```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10

# Identify excluded values for bedtime with y_offset
excluded_bedtime_P05 <- bedtime_data_P05 %>%
  filter(hour_adj < 21 | hour_adj > 26) %>%
  mutate(label = time) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(y_offset = rep(c(25.9, 25.7), length.out = n()))

# Identify excluded values for waketime with bidirectional positioning
excluded_waketime_P05 <- waketime_data_P05 %>%
  filter(hour < 6 | hour > 11) %>%
  mutate(
    label = time,
    triangle_y = ifelse(hour < 6, 6.3, 10.7),
    text_y = ifelse(hour < 6, 6.1, 10.9)
  )

# P05 Bedtime plot
p_bedtime_P05 <- ggplot(bedtime_data_P05, aes(x = date, y = hour_adj)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 22, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = bedtime_color, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = bedtime_color, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  {if(nrow(excluded_bedtime_P05) > 0) {
    geom_point(data = excluded_bedtime_P05, aes(x = date, y = 25.5), 
               size = 3, color = bedtime_color, shape = 17)
  }} +
  {if(nrow(excluded_bedtime_P05) > 0) {
    geom_text(data = excluded_bedtime_P05, aes(x = date, y = y_offset, label = label), 
              size = 3, color = bedtime_color, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")
  }} +
  facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "P05 - Bedtime Adherence", 
       subtitle = "Dashed line = Expected bedtime (22:00) | Note: Missing day 15.07",
       x = "Date", y = "Bedtime") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(21, 26, 0.5),
                     limits = c(21, 26),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(ifelse(x >= 24, x - 24, x)), 
                                                  round((ifelse(x >= 24, x - 24, x) %% 1) * 60))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%d.%m") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10))

print(p_bedtime_P05)

# P05 Waketime plot
p_waketime_P05 <- ggplot(waketime_data_P05, aes(x = date, y = hour)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 6.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 7.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 6.5, ymax = 7.5, alpha = 0.1, fill = "green") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = waketime_color, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = waketime_color, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  {if(nrow(excluded_waketime_P05) > 0) {
    geom_point(data = excluded_waketime_P05, aes(x = date, y = triangle_y), 
               size = 3, color = waketime_color, shape = 17)
  }} +
  {if(nrow(excluded_waketime_P05) > 0) {
    geom_text(data = excluded_waketime_P05, aes(x = date, y = text_y, label = label), 
              size = 3, color = waketime_color, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")
  }} +
  facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "P05 - Waketime Adherence", 
       subtitle = "Dashed lines = Allowed window (06:30 - 07:30) | Triangles indicate values outside scale | Note: Missing day 15.07",
       x = "Date", y = "Waketime") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(6, 11, 0.5),
                     limits = c(6, 11),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(x), round((x %% 1) * 60))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%d.%m") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10))

print(p_waketime_P05)
```

### Deviation Analysis
```{r}
# Pre-Ambulatory Phase
dev_bedtime_preamb_p05 <- bedtime_data_P05 %>%
  filter(phase == "Pre-Ambulatory") %>%
  mutate(
    target = 22,
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs((hour_adj - target) * 60),
    deviation_minutes_signed = (hour_adj - target) * 60
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

dev_waketime_preamb_p05 <- waketime_data_P05 %>%
  filter(phase == "Pre-Ambulatory") %>%
  mutate(
    window_start = 6.5,
    window_end = 7.5,
    deviation_minutes_signed = case_when(
      hour < window_start ~ (hour - window_start) * 60,
      hour > window_end ~ (hour - window_end) * 60,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs(deviation_minutes_signed)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
```

## P06 Analysis

### Data Extraction
```{r}
# Filter data for P06
sleep_P06 <- sleep_sub %>% filter(participant_id == "P06")
```

```{r}
           bedtime_04_lab_P06$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_05_lab_P06$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_06_lab_P06$sd_time_trysleep,
```

### Identify Outliers and Create Plots
```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10

# Identify excluded values for bedtime with y_offset
excluded_bedtime_P06 <- bedtime_data_P06 %>%
  filter(hour_adj < 21 | hour_adj > 26) %>%
  mutate(label = time) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(y_offset = rep(c(25.9, 25.7), length.out = n()))

# Identify excluded values for waketime with bidirectional positioning
excluded_waketime_P06 <- waketime_data_P06 %>%
  filter(hour < 6 | hour > 11) %>%
  mutate(
    label = time,
    triangle_y = ifelse(hour < 6, 6.3, 10.7),
    text_y = ifelse(hour < 6, 6.1, 10.9)
  )

# P06 Bedtime plot
p_bedtime_P06 <- ggplot(bedtime_data_P06, aes(x = date, y = hour_adj)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 23.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = bedtime_color, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = bedtime_color, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  {if(nrow(excluded_bedtime_P06) > 0) {
    geom_point(data = excluded_bedtime_P06, aes(x = date, y = 25.5), 
               size = 3, color = bedtime_color, shape = 17)
  }} +
  {if(nrow(excluded_bedtime_P06) > 0) {
    geom_text(data = excluded_bedtime_P06, aes(x = date, y = y_offset, label = label), 
              size = 3, color = bedtime_color, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")
  }} +
  facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "P06 - Bedtime Adherence", 
       subtitle = "Dashed line = Expected bedtime (23:30)",
       x = "Date", y = "Bedtime") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(21, 26, 0.5),
                     limits = c(21, 26),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(ifelse(x >= 24, x - 24, x)), 
                                                  round((ifelse(x >= 24, x - 24, x) %% 1) * 60))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%d.%m") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10))

print(p_bedtime_P06)

# P06 Waketime plot with bidirectional outlier positioning
p_waketime_P06 <- ggplot(waketime_data_P06, aes(x = date, y = hour)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 7, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 8, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 7, ymax = 8, alpha = 0.1, fill = "green") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = waketime_color, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = waketime_color, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  {if(nrow(excluded_waketime_P06) > 0) {
    geom_point(data = excluded_waketime_P06, aes(x = date, y = triangle_y), 
               size = 3, color = waketime_color, shape = 17)
  }} +
  {if(nrow(excluded_waketime_P06) > 0) {
    geom_text(data = excluded_waketime_P06, aes(x = date, y = text_y, label = label), 
              size = 3, color = waketime_color, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")
  }} +
  facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "P06 - Waketime Adherence", 
       subtitle = "Dashed lines = Allowed window (07:00 - 08:00)",
       x = "Date", y = "Waketime") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(6, 11, 0.5),
                     limits = c(6, 11),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(x), round((x %% 1) * 60))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%d.%m") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10))

print(p_waketime_P06)
```

### Deviation Analysis
```{r}
# Pre-Ambulatory Phase
dev_bedtime_preamb_p06 <- bedtime_data_P06 %>%
  filter(phase == "Pre-Ambulatory") %>%
  mutate(
    target = 23.5,
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs((hour_adj - target) * 60),
    deviation_minutes_signed = (hour_adj - target) * 60
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

dev_waketime_preamb_p06 <- waketime_data_P06 %>%
  filter(phase == "Pre-Ambulatory") %>%
  mutate(
    window_start = 7,
    window_end = 8,
    deviation_minutes_signed = case_when(
      hour < window_start ~ (hour - window_start) * 60,
      hour > window_end ~ (hour - window_end) * 60,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs(deviation_minutes_signed)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

# Laboratory Phase
dev_bedtime_lab_p06 <- bedtime_data_P06 %>%
  filter(phase == "Laboratory") %>%
  mutate(
    target = 23.5,
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs((hour_adj - target) * 60),
    deviation_minutes_signed = (hour_adj - target) * 60
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),

  )

dev_waketime_lab_p06 <- waketime_data_P06 %>%

# Post-Ambulatory Phase

# Create summary table
bind_rows(
  dev_bedtime_preamb_p06 %>% mutate(phase = "Pre-Ambulatory", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_bedtime_lab_p06 %>% mutate(phase = "Laboratory", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_bedtime_postamb_p06 %>% mutate(phase = "Post-Ambulatory", measure = "Bedtime"),

    digits = 1,
    col.names = c("Measure", "Phase", "Mean Deviation (min)", "SD (min)", 
                  "Mean Absolute Deviation (min)", "SD Absolute (min)", "N"),
    caption = "P06 Sleep Schedule Adherence",
    align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "c")
  ) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Arial") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  pack_rows("Bedtime", 1, 3) %>%
  pack_rows("Waketime", 4, 6)
```

### Identify Outliers and Create Plots
```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10

# Identify excluded values for bedtime with y_offset
excluded_bedtime_P07 <- bedtime_data_P07 %>%
  filter(hour_adj < 21 | hour_adj > 26) %>%
  mutate(label = time) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(y_offset = rep(c(25.9, 25.7), length.out = n()))

# Identify excluded values for waketime with bidirectional positioning
excluded_waketime_P07 <- waketime_data_P07 %>%
  filter(hour < 6 | hour > 11) %>%
  mutate(
    label = time,
    triangle_y = ifelse(hour < 6, 6.3, 10.7),
    text_y = ifelse(hour < 6, 6.1, 10.9)
  )

# P07 Bedtime plot
p_bedtime_P07 <- ggplot(bedtime_data_P07, aes(x = date, y = hour_adj)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 23.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = bedtime_color, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = bedtime_color, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  {if(nrow(excluded_bedtime_P07) > 0) {
    geom_point(data = excluded_bedtime_P07, aes(x = date, y = 25.5), 
               size = 3, color = bedtime_color, shape = 17)
  }} +
  {if(nrow(excluded_bedtime_P07) > 0) {
    geom_text(data = excluded_bedtime_P07, aes(x = date, y = y_offset, label = label), 
              size = 3, color = bedtime_color, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")
  }} +
  facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "P07 - Bedtime Adherence", 
       subtitle = "Dashed line = Expected bedtime (23:30)",
       x = "Date", y = "Bedtime") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(21, 26, 0.5),
                     limits = c(21, 26),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(ifelse(x >= 24, x - 24, x)), 
                                                  round((ifelse(x >= 24, x - 24, x) %% 1) * 60))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%d.%m") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10))

print(p_bedtime_P07)

# P07 Waketime plot with bidirectional outlier positioning
p_waketime_P07 <- ggplot(waketime_data_P07, aes(x = date, y = hour)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 7, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 8, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 7, ymax = 8, alpha = 0.1, fill = "green") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = waketime_color, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = waketime_color, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  {if(nrow(excluded_waketime_P07) > 0) {
    geom_point(data = excluded_waketime_P07, aes(x = date, y = triangle_y), 
               size = 3, color = waketime_color, shape = 17)
  }} +
  {if(nrow(excluded_waketime_P07) > 0) {
    geom_text(data = excluded_waketime_P07, aes(x = date, y = text_y, label = label), 
              size = 3, color = waketime_color, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")
  }} +
  facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "P07 - Waketime Adherence", 
       subtitle = "Dashed lines = Allowed window (07:00 - 08:00) | Triangles indicate values outside scale",
       x = "Date", y = "Waketime") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(6, 11, 0.5),
                     limits = c(6, 11),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(x), round((x %% 1) * 60))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%d.%m") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10))

print(p_waketime_P07)
```

### Deviation Analysis
```{r}
# Pre-Ambulatory Phase
dev_bedtime_preamb_p07 <- bedtime_data_P07 %>%
  filter(phase == "Pre-Ambulatory") %>%
  mutate(
    target = 23.5,
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs((hour_adj - target) * 60),
    deviation_minutes_signed = (hour_adj - target) * 60
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

dev_waketime_preamb_p07 <- waketime_data_P07 %>%
  filter(phase == "Pre-Ambulatory") %>%
  mutate(
    window_start = 7,
    window_end = 8,
    deviation_minutes_signed = case_when(
      hour < window_start ~ (hour - window_start) * 60,
      hour > window_end ~ (hour - window_end) * 60,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs(deviation_minutes_signed)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

# Laboratory Phase
dev_bedtime_lab_p07 <- bedtime_data_P07 %>%
  filter(phase == "Laboratory") %>%
  mutate(
    target = 23.5,
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs((hour_adj - target) * 60),
    deviation_minutes_signed = (hour_adj - target) * 60
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

dev_waketime_lab_p07 <- waketime_data_P07 %>%

    window_end = 8,
    deviation_minutes_signed = case_when(

# Create summary table
bind_rows(
  dev_bedtime_preamb_p07 %>% mutate(phase = "Pre-Ambulatory", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_bedtime_lab_p07 %>% mutate(phase = "Laboratory", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_bedtime_postamb_p07 %>% mutate(phase = "Post-Ambulatory", measure = "Bedtime"),

  select(measure, phase, mean_dev_signed, sd_dev_signed, mean_dev_abs, sd_dev_abs, n) %>%
  kable(
    digits = 1,
    col.names = c("Measure", "Phase", "Mean Deviation (min)", "SD (min)", 
                  "Mean Absolute Deviation (min)", "SD Absolute (min)", "N"),
    caption = "P07 Sleep Schedule Adherence",
    align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "c")
  ) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Arial") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  pack_rows("Bedtime", 1, 3) %>%
  pack_rows("Waketime", 4, 6)
```

## P09 Analysis

**Note on P09 Data:**
P09 had a data entry error where the entry for 2025-07-21 (Pre-Ambulatory Day 1) was incorrectly timestamped as 2025-07-28 07:15:00 in `timestamp_self`, while `timestamp_auto` correctly shows 2025-07-21. The mislabeled entry has been removed from the dataset.

### Data Extraction
```{r}

sleep_P09 <- sleep_sub %>% filter(participant_id == "P09")

# Day 7 (27.07) - bedtime using timestamp_auto for 28.07, waketime normal
```

### Identify Outliers and Create Plots
```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10

# Identify excluded values for bedtime with y_offset
excluded_bedtime_P09 <- bedtime_data_P09 %>%
  filter(hour_adj < 21 | hour_adj > 26) %>%
  mutate(label = time) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(y_offset = rep(c(25.9, 25.7), length.out = n()))

# Identify excluded values for waketime with bidirectional positioning
excluded_waketime_P09 <- waketime_data_P09 %>%
  filter(hour < 6 | hour > 11) %>%
  mutate(
    label = time,
    triangle_y = ifelse(hour < 6, 6.3, 10.7),
    text_y = ifelse(hour < 6, 6.1, 10.9)
  )

# P09 Bedtime plot
p_bedtime_P09 <- ggplot(bedtime_data_P09, aes(x = date, y = hour_adj)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 23.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = bedtime_color, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = bedtime_color, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  {if(nrow(excluded_bedtime_P09) > 0) {
    geom_point(data = excluded_bedtime_P09, aes(x = date, y = 25.5), 
               size = 3, color = bedtime_color, shape = 17)
  }} +
  {if(nrow(excluded_bedtime_P09) > 0) {
    geom_text(data = excluded_bedtime_P09, aes(x = date, y = y_offset, label = label), 
              size = 3, color = bedtime_color, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")
  }} +
  facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "P09 - Bedtime Adherence", 
       subtitle = "Dashed line = Expected bedtime (23:30)",
       x = "Date", y = "Bedtime") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(21, 26, 0.5),
                     limits = c(21, 26),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(ifelse(x >= 24, x - 24, x)), 
                                                  round((ifelse(x >= 24, x - 24, x) %% 1) * 60))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%d.%m") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10))

print(p_bedtime_P09)

# P09 Waketime plot
p_waketime_P09 <- ggplot(waketime_data_P09, aes(x = date, y = hour)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 7.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 8.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 7.5, ymax = 8.5, alpha = 0.1, fill = "green") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = waketime_color, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = waketime_color, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  {if(nrow(excluded_waketime_P09) > 0) {
    geom_point(data = excluded_waketime_P09, aes(x = date, y = triangle_y), 
               size = 3, color = waketime_color, shape = 17)
  }} +
  {if(nrow(excluded_waketime_P09) > 0) {
    geom_text(data = excluded_waketime_P09, aes(x = date, y = text_y, label = label), 
              size = 3, color = waketime_color, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")
  }} +
  facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "P09 - Waketime Adherence", 
       subtitle = "Dashed lines = Allowed window (07:30 - 08:30) | Triangles indicate values outside scale",
       x = "Date", y = "Waketime") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(6, 11, 0.5),
                     limits = c(6, 11),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(x), round((x %% 1) * 60))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%d.%m") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10))

print(p_waketime_P09)
```

### Deviation Analysis
```{r}
# Pre-Ambulatory Phase
dev_bedtime_preamb_p09 <- bedtime_data_P09 %>%
  filter(phase == "Pre-Ambulatory") %>%
  mutate(
    target = 23.5,
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs((hour_adj - target) * 60),
    deviation_minutes_signed = (hour_adj - target) * 60
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

dev_waketime_preamb_p09 <- waketime_data_P09 %>%
  filter(phase == "Pre-Ambulatory") %>%
  mutate(
    window_start = 7.5,
    window_end = 8.5,
    deviation_minutes_signed = case_when(
      hour < window_start ~ (hour - window_start) * 60,
      hour > window_end ~ (hour - window_end) * 60,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs(deviation_minutes_signed)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

# Laboratory Phase
dev_bedtime_lab_p09 <- bedtime_data_P09 %>%
  filter(phase == "Laboratory") %>%
  mutate(
    target = 23.5,
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs((hour_adj - target) * 60),
    deviation_minutes_signed = (hour_adj - target) * 60
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

dev_waketime_lab_p09 <- waketime_data_P09 %>%
  filter(phase == "Laboratory") %>%
  mutate(
    window_start = 7.5,
    window_end = 8.5,
    deviation_minutes_signed = case_when(
      hour < window_start ~ (hour - window_start) * 60,
      hour > window_end ~ (hour - window_end) * 60,

# Post-Ambulatory Phase

# Create summary table
bind_rows(
  dev_bedtime_preamb_p09 %>% mutate(phase = "Pre-Ambulatory", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_bedtime_lab_p09 %>% mutate(phase = "Laboratory", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_bedtime_postamb_p09 %>% mutate(phase = "Post-Ambulatory", measure = "Bedtime"),

  select(measure, phase, mean_dev_signed, sd_dev_signed, mean_dev_abs, sd_dev_abs, n) %>%
  kable(
    digits = 1,
    col.names = c("Measure", "Phase", "Mean Deviation (min)", "SD (min)", 
                  "Mean Absolute Deviation (min)", "SD Absolute (min)", "N"),
    caption = "P09 Sleep Schedule Adherence",
    align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "c")
  ) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Arial") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  pack_rows("Bedtime", 1, 3) %>%
  pack_rows("Waketime", 4, 6)
```

## P10 Analysis

**Note on P10 Laboratory Phase:**
P10 is from Group 4 with a 13-day laboratory phase. However, Session 5 (2025-08-15) was excluded from all analyses due to a light automation malfunction during the in-laboratory phase. Therefore, data extraction skips Session 5 entirely, resulting in 12 valid laboratory sessions.

```{r}
bedtime_data_P10 <- tibble(
  date = as.Date(c("2025-08-04", "2025-08-05", "2025-08-06", "2025-08-07", "2025-08-08", "2025-08-09", "2025-08-10",
                   "2025-08-11", "2025-08-12", "2025-08-13", "2025-08-14", "2025-08-16", "2025-08-17", "2025-08-18",
                   "2025-08-19", "2025-08-20", "2025-08-21", "2025-08-22", "2025-08-23",
                   "2025-08-24", "2025-08-25", "2025-08-26", "2025-08-27", "2025-08-28", "2025-08-29", "2025-08-30")),
  phase = factor(c(rep("Pre-Ambulatory", 7), rep("Laboratory", 12), rep("Post-Ambulatory", 7)),
                 levels = c("Pre-Ambulatory", "Laboratory", "Post-Ambulatory")),
  time = c(bedtime_01_preamb_P10$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_02_preamb_P10$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_03_preamb_P10$sd_time_trysleep,
           bedtime_04_preamb_P10$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_05_preamb_P10$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_06_preamb_P10$sd_time_trysleep,
           bedtime_07_preamb_P10$sd_time_trysleep,
           bedtime_01_lab_P10$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_02_lab_P10$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_03_lab_P10$sd_time_trysleep,
           bedtime_04_lab_P10$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_06_lab_P10$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_07_lab_P10$sd_time_trysleep,
           bedtime_08_lab_P10$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_09_lab_P10$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_10_lab_P10$sd_time_trysleep,
           bedtime_11_lab_P10$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_12_lab_P10$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_13_lab_P10$sd_time_trysleep,
           bedtime_01_postamb_P10$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_02_postamb_P10$sd_time_trysleep, bedtime_03_postamb_P10$sd_time_trysleep,
```
