### Identify Outliers and Create Plots
```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10

# Identify excluded values for bedtime with y_offset
excluded_bedtime_P10 <- bedtime_data_P10 %>%
  filter(hour_adj < 21 | hour_adj > 26) %>%
  mutate(label = time) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(y_offset = rep(c(25.9, 25.7), length.out = n()))

# Identify excluded values for waketime with bidirectional positioning
excluded_waketime_P10 <- waketime_data_P10 %>%
  filter(hour < 6 | hour > 11) %>%
  mutate(
    label = time,
    triangle_y = ifelse(hour < 6, 6.3, 10.7),
    text_y = ifelse(hour < 6, 6.1, 10.9)
  )

# P10 Bedtime plot
p_bedtime_P10 <- ggplot(bedtime_data_P10, aes(x = date, y = hour_adj)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 23, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = bedtime_color, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = bedtime_color, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  {if(nrow(excluded_bedtime_P10) > 0) {
    geom_point(data = excluded_bedtime_P10, aes(x = date, y = 25.5), 
               size = 3, color = bedtime_color, shape = 17)
  }} +
  {if(nrow(excluded_bedtime_P10) > 0) {
    geom_text(data = excluded_bedtime_P10, aes(x = date, y = y_offset, label = label), 
              size = 3, color = bedtime_color, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")
  }} +
  facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "P10 - Bedtime Adherence", 
       subtitle = "Dashed line = Expected bedtime (23:00) | Note: Session 5 (Aug 15) excluded",
       x = "Date", y = "Bedtime") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(21, 26, 0.5),
                     limits = c(21, 26),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(ifelse(x >= 24, x - 24, x)), 
                                                  round((ifelse(x >= 24, x - 24, x) %% 1) * 60))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%d.%m") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10))

print(p_bedtime_P10)

# P10 Waketime plot with bidirectional outlier positioning
p_waketime_P10 <- ggplot(waketime_data_P10, aes(x = date, y = hour)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 7.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 8.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 7.5, ymax = 8.5, alpha = 0.1, fill = "green") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = waketime_color, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = waketime_color, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  {if(nrow(excluded_waketime_P10) > 0) {
    geom_point(data = excluded_waketime_P10, aes(x = date, y = triangle_y), 
               size = 3, color = waketime_color, shape = 17)
  }} +
  {if(nrow(excluded_waketime_P10) > 0) {
    geom_text(data = excluded_waketime_P10, aes(x = date, y = text_y, label = label), 
              size = 3, color = waketime_color, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold")
  }} +
  facet_wrap(~ phase, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "P10 - Waketime Adherence", 
       subtitle = "Dashed lines = Allowed window (07:30 - 08:30) | Note: Session 5 (Aug 15) excluded",
       x = "Date", y = "Waketime") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(6, 11, 0.5),
                     limits = c(6, 11),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:%02d", floor(x), round((x %% 1) * 60))) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%d.%m") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 10))

print(p_waketime_P10)
```

### Deviation Analysis
```{r}
# Pre-Ambulatory Phase
dev_bedtime_preamb_p10 <- bedtime_data_P10 %>%
  filter(phase == "Pre-Ambulatory") %>%
  mutate(
    target = 23,
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs((hour_adj - target) * 60),
    deviation_minutes_signed = (hour_adj - target) * 60
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

dev_waketime_preamb_p10 <- waketime_data_P10 %>%
  filter(phase == "Pre-Ambulatory") %>%
  mutate(
    window_start = 7.5,
    window_end = 8.5,
    deviation_minutes_signed = case_when(
      hour < window_start ~ (hour - window_start) * 60,
      hour > window_end ~ (hour - window_end) * 60,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs(deviation_minutes_signed)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

# Laboratory Phase
dev_bedtime_lab_p10 <- bedtime_data_P10 %>%
  filter(phase == "Laboratory") %>%
  mutate(
    target = 23,
    deviation_minutes_abs = abs((hour_adj - target) * 60),
    deviation_minutes_signed = (hour_adj - target) * 60
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_dev_abs = mean(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_abs = sd(deviation_minutes_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_signed = mean(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_dev_signed = sd(deviation_minutes_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

dev_waketime_lab_p10 <- waketime_data_P10 %>%
  filter(phase == "Laboratory") %>%
  mutate(
    window_start = 7.5,
    window_end = 8.5,
    deviation_minutes_signed = case_when(
      hour < window_start ~ (hour - window_start) * 60,
      hour > window_end ~ (hour - window_end) * 60,

    ),

  )

# Post-Ambulatory Phase

    target = 23,

dev_waketime_postamb_p10 <- waketime_data_P10 %>%

    window_start = 7.5,
    window_end = 8.5,
    deviation_minutes_signed = case_when(

# Create summary table
bind_rows(
  dev_bedtime_preamb_p10 %>% mutate(phase = "Pre-Ambulatory", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_bedtime_lab_p10 %>% mutate(phase = "Laboratory", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_bedtime_postamb_p10 %>% mutate(phase = "Post-Ambulatory", measure = "Bedtime"),

  select(measure, phase, mean_dev_signed, sd_dev_signed, mean_dev_abs, sd_dev_abs, n) %>%
  kable(
    digits = 1,
    col.names = c("Measure", "Phase", "Mean Deviation (min)", "SD (min)", 
                  "Mean Absolute Deviation (min)", "SD Absolute (min)", "N"),
    caption = "P10 Sleep Schedule Adherence",
    align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "c")
  ) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Arial") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  pack_rows("Bedtime", 1, 3) %>%
  pack_rows("Waketime", 4, 6)
```

```{r}
  dev_waketime_postamb_p03 %>% mutate(participant = "P03", measure = "Waketime"),
  dev_bedtime_postamb_p04 %>% mutate(participant = "P04", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_waketime_postamb_p04 %>% mutate(participant = "P04", measure = "Waketime"),
  dev_bedtime_postamb_p05 %>% mutate(participant = "P05", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_waketime_postamb_p05 %>% mutate(participant = "P05", measure = "Waketime"),
  dev_bedtime_postamb_p06 %>% mutate(participant = "P06", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_waketime_postamb_p06 %>% mutate(participant = "P06", measure = "Waketime"),
  dev_bedtime_postamb_p07 %>% mutate(participant = "P07", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_waketime_postamb_p07 %>% mutate(participant = "P07", measure = "Waketime"),
  dev_bedtime_postamb_p09 %>% mutate(participant = "P09", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_waketime_postamb_p09 %>% mutate(participant = "P09", measure = "Waketime"),
  dev_bedtime_postamb_p10 %>% mutate(participant = "P10", measure = "Bedtime"),
  dev_waketime_postamb_p10 %>% mutate(participant = "P10", measure = "Waketime")
) %>%
  select(participant, measure, mean_dev_signed, sd_dev_signed, mean_dev_abs, sd_dev_abs, n) %>%
  arrange(participant, measure)

# Display table
summary_postamb %>%
  kable(
    digits = 1,
    col.names = c("Participant", "Measure", "Mean Deviation (min)", "SD (min)", 
                  "Mean Absolute Deviation (min)", "SD Absolute (min)", "N"),
    caption = "Post-Ambulatory Phase: Sleep Schedule Adherence Across All Participants",
    align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "c")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

### Pre-Ambulatory Phase: Group Average (Excluding P07)
```{r}
# Calculate group averages for Pre-Ambulatory phase (without P07)
avg_preamb_bedtime <- summary_preamb %>%
  filter(measure == "Bedtime", participant != "P07") %>%
  summarise(
    measure = "Bedtime",
    mean_dev_mean = mean(mean_dev_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_sd = sd(mean_dev_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abs_mean = mean(mean_dev_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abs_sd = sd(mean_dev_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_n = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

avg_preamb_waketime <- summary_preamb %>%
  filter(measure == "Waketime", participant != "P07") %>%
  summarise(
    measure = "Waketime",
    mean_dev_mean = mean(mean_dev_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dev_sd = sd(mean_dev_signed, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abs_mean = mean(mean_dev_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abs_sd = sd(mean_dev_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_n = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Combine and display
bind_rows(avg_preamb_bedtime, avg_preamb_waketime) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_dev_formatted = sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f min", mean_dev_mean, mean_dev_sd),
    mean_abs_formatted = sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f min", mean_abs_mean, mean_abs_sd)
  ) %>%
  select(measure, mean_dev_formatted, mean_abs_formatted, total_n) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Measure", "Mean Deviation (M±SD)", "Mean Absolute Deviation (M±SD)", "Total N"),
    caption = "Pre-Ambulatory Phase: Group Average Sleep Schedule Adherence (n=8, excluding P07)",
    align = c("l", "r", "r", "c")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```
